data.title: Peak Credit Union Announces Agreement to Acquire Southwest Heritage Bank
data.description:
The proposed acquisition would deepen business banking expertise and expand Peak's reach into Arizona and New Mexico

EUGENE, Ore. and LACEY, Wash. and SCOTTSDALE, Ariz., Nov. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Peak Credit Union announced today that it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire all assets and assume all liabilities of Southwest Heritage Bank, a subsidiary of Bancorp 34, Inc. (), in an all-cash transaction.

The proposed acquisition would bring together Peak's broad consumer financial services and member-owned cooperative model with Southwest Heritage's commercial lending expertise, treasury management services, and established business relationships across Arizona and New Mexico. The combination is intended to expand the financial resources available to individuals and business owners while preserving the local expertise and personal relationships valued by Southwest Heritage customers.

"Our focus is on finding meaningful ways to serve more people," said Dr. David L. Tuyo II, president and CEO of Peak Credit Union. "We know many of our members already spend part of the year in Arizona, making it a natural place for us to grow. Southwest Heritage has built trusted relationships with local businesses, backed by people who understand their communities. Bringing that expertise together with Peak's broader capabilities gives us an opportunity to help more people and businesses move toward their financial goals."

Over time, Peak members could benefit from deeper commercial lending and treasury management capabilities, while Southwest Heritage customers could gain access to additional consumer financial services. Specific products, eligibility, and timing will be determined as integration planning progresses.

The employees and relationships of Southwest Heritage Bank are central to the value of the planned transition. Peak intends to retain Southwest Heritage employees at closing, subject to ordinary business and individual circumstances, to support service continuity and integration. Peak also intends to retain members of Southwest Heritage's executive leadership team in senior roles. Final roles and reporting relationships remain subject to approval and integration planning.

There are no immediate changes to branch operations, accounts, or banking services as a result of today's announcement. Until the transaction closes, the two organizations are expected to continue to operate independently, and members and customers do not need to take any action. It is expected that Peak will communicate any future changes directly and in advance.

The boards of directors of Peak Credit Union, Southwest Heritage Bank and Bancorp 34, Inc. approved the agreement unanimously. The transaction remains subject to customary regulatory and shareholder approvals and is expected to close in the second half of 2027.

Following closing, Southwest Heritage Bank and Bancorp 34, Inc. is expected to dissolve and distribute the remaining assets of Bancorp 34, Inc. to its shareholders in accordance with the transaction terms.

D.A. Davidson & Co. served as financial advisor and Otteson Shapiro LLP served as legal counsel to Southwest Heritage Bank and Bancorp 34, Inc. McQueen Financial Advisors served as financial advisor and Luse Gorman, PC served as legal counsel to Peak Credit Union.

About Peak Credit Union: Peak Credit Union is a member-owned, not-for-profit financial cooperative serving more than 250,000 members through 35 branches across Washington and Oregon and digital banking services. Formed from the combination of TwinStar Credit Union and Northwest Community Credit Union, Peak brings a longstanding commitment to financial education, accessible financial services and community well-being. Through the PeakCU Foundation, Peak supports local initiatives including classroom grants, scholarships and financial education. Federally insured by NCUA. Equal Housing Opportunity. Learn more at peakcu.org.

About Southwest Heritage Bank: Southwest Heritage Bank, headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, is a community-focused bank serving individuals and businesses in Arizona and New Mexico. The bank offers commercial lending, treasury management and personal financial services, with an emphasis on local relationships and responsive service. Southwest Heritage Bank is a subsidiary of Bancorp 34, Inc. (). Member FDIC. Learn more at swhbank.com.

data.title: S&P revises Hungary outlook to stable as fiscal risks ease
data.description:
Credit ratings agency S&P on Friday revised Hungary's outlook to stable from negative, saying strong institutional and fiscal frameworks would ensure a steady decline in budgetary deficits over the next two years.

The outlook revision follows six months of reforms by Prime Minister Peter Magyar that improved ties with European Union institutions, unlocking €16.4 billion in previously suspended EU funding and easing concerns over the country's financing outlook.

"We forecast that Hungary’s economic activity will rebound in 2027 and remain steady through 2029," the agency said.

Magyar Nemzeti Bank, the Hungarian central bank, has grown more cautious amid renewed pressure on the forint. Having signaled room for a rate cut as early as next month, it adopted a more guarded tone after dovish remarks pushed the currency to a seven-month low last week.

However, S&P added that forint appreciation has mitigated commodity price volatility. The agency also affirmed the sovereign's rating at "BBB-/A-3".

The decision aligns S&P with peer Moody's, which last week lifted Hungary's outlook to stable while affirming its sovereign rating at "Baa2".

data.title: Copper One Completes Fourth Hole of 2026 Phase 2 Drill Program (MHB-42) at Flagship Majuba Hill Copper Project, Nevada
data.description:
(TheNewswire)

Vancouver, BC – November 27, 2026 – TheNewswire - Copper One Resources Corp. (“Copper One”) (CSE: CEXY | OTCID: CEXYF | FSE: IW8 | WKN: A42AGR) (the “Company”) announces the completion of drill hole MHB-42, the fourth hole of its 2026 Phase 2 diamond drilling program of up to 10,000 feet at its 100%-owned flagship Majuba Hill Copper-Silver-Gold Project (“Majuba Hill” or the “Project”) in Pershing County, Nevada.

MHB-42 reached a final downhole depth of 1,510 feet (460 metres). Preliminary geological core logging identified pervasive silicification with fine-grained pyrite and chalcopyrite, tourmaline breccia at multiple depths, and fracture coatings of hematite and tenorite. These observations provide additional geological information to support the Company’s ongoing evaluation of alteration and mineralization at Majuba Hill.

MHB-42 Highlights

  • Hole orientation and depth: MHB-42 was drilled at a grid azimuth of 350° at an inclination of −80° to a final downhole depth of 1,510 feet (460 metres).

  • Phase 2 drilling to date: MHB-39 through MHB-42 now account for a combined 6,435 feet (1,961 metres) of completed diamond drilling.

All depths are downhole. The intervals cited for the tourmaline breccia photographs represent full core-box intervals and do not establish continuous mineralized widths. Mineral identifications are preliminary field observations. Visual observations do not determine metal grades or establish economic mineralization and should not be considered a substitute for laboratory assay results.

No laboratory assay results from MHB-42 are being reported in this news release. Any material analytical results will be disclosed after receipt, quality assurance and quality control review, and evaluation by the Company’s Qualified Person.

Click Image To View Full Size

Figure 1: Drill core from 798 feet (243 metres) downhole in MHB-42, showing secondary copper mineralization along a fracture in silicified rhyolite with quartz–sericite–pyrite alteration. Mineral identifications are based on visual observations and have not been confirmed by laboratory analysis.

David Greenway, President and Chief Executive Officer of Copper One, commented, “We’re thrilled to report that our geologists visually identified mineralization near the surface and at intervals throughout MHB-42, down to its final depth of 1,510 feet (460 metres). Seeing mineralization over that downhole range is an exciting milestone for our team as we complete the fourth hole of our 2026 Phase 2 drilling program at Majuba Hill. Majuba Hill remains central to our North American copper exploration strategy. We’re eager to see the assay results, which will tell us the copper grades in the sampled intervals. Those results, together with our geological logging, will help us understand how MHB-42 fits into the broader mineralized system and where to drill next.”

Click Image To View Full Size

Figure 2: Drill core from approximately 290 feet (88 metres) downhole in MHB-42, showing mineralized tourmaline breccia. Mineral identifications are based on visual observations and have not been confirmed by laboratory analysis.

The Company’s expanded Phase 2 diamond core drilling program (the “Phase 2 Program”) comprises up to 10,000 feet (3,048 metres) of HQ/PQ diamond core drilling. The Phase 2 Program is intended to accelerate systematic testing of priority targets at Majuba Hill and support the Company’s objective of advancing the Project toward an inaugural mineral resource estimate prepared in accordance with National Instrument 43-101 – Standards of Disclosure for Mineral Projects (“NI 43-101”). More than 95,000 feet (28,956 metres) have been drilled to date at Majuba Hill across more than 100 drill holes.

Phase 2 Program Highlights

  • Expanded program of up to 10,000 feet (3,048 metres) of diamond core drilling.


  • Evolve contracted to drill approximately 5,000 feet (1,524 metres) in the initial scope using one portable HQ/PQ core drill.


  • Continuous two-shift drilling operations planned 24 hours a day, seven days a week.


  • Maximum planned hole depth of approximately 1,850 feet (564 metres) under the initial scope, with final collar locations, azimuths, inclinations and depths to be determined by the Company’s technical team.


  • Real-time operational visibility through Evolve’s EVX Connect platform.


Click Image To View Full Size

Figure 3: Drill core from approximately 33 feet (10 metres) downhole in MHB-42, showing mineralized tourmaline breccia. Mineral identifications are based on visual observations and have not been confirmed by laboratory analysis.

Real-Time Drill Program Technology

As previously announced, the Company engaged Evolve Exploration Nevada, LLC (“Evolve”) to undertake the Phase 2 diamond core drilling.

Every Evolve drill rig operates on EVX Connect, Evolve’s real-time operational platform. Through EVX Connect, Copper One expects to receive live drilling metrics, digital Progressive Logs of Drilling (“PLOD”), drill-hole coordinate tracking, streamlined invoicing and high-quality photographs of drill core as it is recovered. Information will be accessible through web and mobile interfaces, providing the Company’s technical and management teams with timely visibility into drilling progress and field operations.

About the Majuba Hill Copper-Silver-Gold Project, Nevada

Majuba Hill is Copper One Resources Corp.’s flagship copper-silver-gold exploration project, located in Pershing County, Nevada, USA. Nevada ranked first globally on the Investment Attractiveness Index in the Fraser Institute’s Annual Survey of Mining Companies 2025. The property comprises approximately 9,684 acres (3,919 hectares) and is situated approximately 70 miles (113 road kilometres) southwest of Winnemucca and 156 miles (251 kilometres) northeast of Reno.

The project benefits from excellent infrastructure, including year-round road access, nearby electrical power and water, and access to a skilled mining workforce. Majuba Hill is a past-producing copper mine with an extensive exploration database, including records from historical and recent drilling programs, providing a strong technical foundation for ongoing exploration aimed at further defining the extent and economic potential of the mineralized system.

Exploration has outlined a large copper-silver-gold hydrothermal mineralized system that remains open for expansion. Current exploration is focused on advancing the Company’s geological model through systematic drilling, geological mapping, geochemical sampling and structural interpretation to evaluate the scale, continuity and significance of mineralization. Additional drilling and technical studies will be required to further define the extent and economic potential of the mineralized system.

Data Verification and Quality Assurance/Quality Control

The Company maintains geological logging, core photography and drill-record procedures for its Phase 2 drilling program at Majuba Hill. Mineral identifications reported for drill hole MHB-42 are based on preliminary visual field observations and geological interpretations. These observations do not establish metal grades, mineralized widths or economic significance and should not be considered a substitute for laboratory assay results.

Qualified Person

The scientific and technical information contained in this news release has been reviewed and approved by Larry Segerstrom, M.Sc. (Geology), CPG, a non-independent consulting geologist to the Company and a Qualified Person as defined by National Instrument 43-101 – Standards of Disclosure for Mineral Projects.

About Copper One Resources Corp.

Copper One Resources Corp. is focused on identifying, acquiring and advancing high-potential copper, copper-silver-gold and copper-molybdenum projects to help meet global demand for critical metals used in electrification, AI infrastructure and data centres, renewable energy, defence and power system modernization.

The Company’s flagship asset is the Majuba Hill Copper-Silver-Gold District, located approximately 156 miles (251 kilometres) from Reno, Nevada. Majuba Hill is an exploration-stage porphyry copper project situated in an established mining jurisdiction with existing infrastructure, where ongoing exploration is focused on evaluating the scale and continuity of a copper-silver-gold mineralized system.

Copper One also owns a 100% interest in the Redonda Copper-Molybdenum Project, located northeast of Campbell River in British Columbia’s Vancouver Mining Division. The district-scale project comprises approximately 2,746.46 hectares (6,786 acres) across nine mineral claims and hosts a porphyry-style copper-molybdenum system within the Coast Suture Zone, a geological belt known for porphyry copper and skarn mineralization. Systematic exploration is continuing to evaluate the scale and continuity of the mineralized system.

In addition, Copper One holds an option to earn up to a 100% interest in the Redhill Property, located south of Ashcroft, British Columbia, adjacent to the Trans-Canada Highway. The 4,736-hectare (11,704-acre) property hosts volcanogenic massive sulfide (VMS) mineralization prospective for copper, zinc, silver and gold and also has potential for epithermal gold mineralization.

Copper One also owns a 100% interest in the Sport Project in Utah through its wholly owned subsidiary, Rooinek Mining Corp., expanding the Company’s portfolio of North American copper exploration assets.

Copper One is advancing its portfolio through systematic exploration, modern geological modelling and disciplined technical evaluation. The Company remains committed to responsible exploration practices, technical transparency and the disciplined advancement of critical-metals projects across North America.

data.description:
NOT FOR DISTRIBUTION TO UNITED STATES NEWSWIRE SERVICES OR FOR DISSEMINATION IN THE UNITED STATES

CALGARY, Alberta, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Vitalist Inc. (TSX-V: VITA.V; OTCQB: VTLSF) (“Vitalist” or the “Company”), a wearable technology company and developer of the VitalOS™ operating system, announces that it has received a 30-day extension from the TSX Venture Exchange (the “TSXV”) to extend the closing date of its previously announced concurrent non-brokered private placements (collectively, the “Offerings”), first announced on October 13, 2026, from November 27, 2026, to December 27, 2026.

The Offerings consist of: (i) a non-brokered equity private placement of up to 5,882,352 units at a price of C$0.85 per unit for gross proceeds of up to C$5,000,000, with each unit consisting of one common share and one common share purchase warrant exercisable at C$1.00 per share for 24 months; and (ii) a non-brokered private placement of unsecured convertible debentures for gross proceeds of up to C$5,000,000 bearing interest at 12% per annum (paid-in-kind), maturing three years from issuance, with principal convertible at an 80% discount to the offering price of a qualified U.S. public offering (or 10-day VWAP at maturity), subject to a minimum TSXV price floor of C$0.68 and a maximum conversion price cap of C$1.20 per share.

Further to the Company’s news release dated October 13, 2026, the terms of the convertible debentures were updated to include the C$1.20 maximum conversion price cap and to remove the Company’s forced conversion option. All other material terms and conditions of the Offerings remain unchanged from those disclosed in the October 13, 2026 news release, which is available under the Company’s profile on SEDAR+ at www.sedarplus.ca.

The extension provides additional time for the Company to complete the Offerings with subscribers that have expressed interest. Closing of the Offerings remains subject to customary conditions, including receipt of all necessary regulatory approvals and final acceptance of the TSXV. The securities issued at each closing of the Offerings will be subject to a statutory hold period of four months and one day from their respective dates of issuance in accordance with applicable Canadian securities legislation, including National Instrument 45-102 – Resale of Securities, and any applicable TSXV hold period. Common shares issued on exercise of the warrants or conversion of debenture principal will be subject to applicable resale restrictions, including any remaining portion of the hold period applicable to the original security. Common shares issued in payment of accrued interest will be subject to the resale restrictions applicable at the time of that issuance. Securities issued in the United States or to U.S. persons, will constitute “restricted securities” within the meaning of Rule 144 under the United States Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the “U.S. Securities Act”), and will be subject to applicable U.S. resale restrictions. Expiry of the Canadian hold period does not remove applicable U.S. resale restrictions.

Reebok Kinetic, Powered by VitalOS, Now Available in Canada and the United States

Vitalist is pleased to announce that the Reebok Kinetic smartwatch, powered by VitalOS, is now available to consumers in Canada and the United States. The Reebok Kinetic is designed and developed by Vitalist under its multi-year licensing agreement with Authentic Brands Group and is the first commercial device built on the Company’s proprietary operating system.

VitalOS™ is a wearable operating system developed in partnership with MicroEJ, using MicroEJ’s virtualization technology. It is designed to address a long-standing trade-off in the smartwatch category between battery life and the ability to run third-party applications. Key characteristics include:

  • Battery efficiency: VitalOS currently delivers +5 days of battery life on a single charge while supporting third-party applications.
  • Updatable over time: new features and algorithm improvements can be delivered from the user’s phone to the watch, allowing devices to improve after purchase.
  • Third-party app support: Reebok Kinetic ships with Facer pre-installed, giving users access to a large library of customizable watch faces.

“Bringing the Reebok Kinetic to market in Canada and the United States is an important milestone for Vitalist,” said Kalvie Legat, CEO of Vitalist. “It is the first time VitalOS is in consumers’ hands at scale, and it gives us a platform to build on with our current and prospective partners looking for a flexible operating system for their wearables. We see this as the beginning of a new phase for the Company.”

About Vitalist Inc.

Vitalist Inc. is an innovative technology provider that helps brands build better products. Through VitalOS™, brands create seamlessly connected devices and applications that adapt to each user. By uniting hardware and software with intelligent analytics, we're building an ecosystem of personalized solutions that enhance human potential.

data.title: MMA.INC Provides NYSE American Listing Update
data.description:
New York, NY, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Mixed Martial Arts Group Limited (NYSE American: MMA), doing business as MMA.INC, today advised that on November 25, 2026 it received a letter from NYSE Regulation notifying the Company that it is below compliance with the continued listing standard in Section 1003(a)(i) of the NYSE American Company Guide, which requires stockholders’ equity of US$2.0 million or more where a company has reported losses in two of its three most recent fiscal years. The notification relates to the stockholders’ equity position reported in the Company’s audited financial statements as at June 30, 2026. Release of this information is required by Sections 402(g) and 1009(j) of the Company Guide.

The Company is now subject to the procedures and requirements of Section 1009 of the Company Guide. The Company intends to submit a plan to NYSE American by December 25, 2026, setting out the actions it has taken or will take to regain compliance with the continued listing standards by May 25, 2028. If NYSE American accepts the plan, the Company will be subject to periodic review, including quarterly monitoring for compliance with the plan. If the plan is not accepted, or if the Company is not in compliance by May 25, 2028 or does not make progress consistent with the plan, NYSE American may initiate delisting proceedings.

Following the June 30, 2026 financial year end, the Company completed a US$4 million ordinary share equity capital raising at US$1.00 per share in August 2026. As announced on September 29, 2026, completed cost reduction actions increased the Company’s estimated total annualized cash operating cost reductions to over US$2.51 million, including over US$800,000 of additional annualized reductions implemented between July 1 and September 28, 2026.

The Company’s ordinary shares continue to trade on NYSE American. The notification has no effect on the Company’s business or operations, or on its reporting obligations under U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission rules.

For more information, visit www.mma.inc

Cautionary Statement Regarding Forward-Looking Statements

This press release contains forward-looking statements within the meaning of Section 27A of the Securities Act of 1933 and Section 21E of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as added by the U.S. Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995, including statements regarding the Company’s intention to submit a compliance plan and its initiatives to strengthen its balance sheet. There can be no assurance that any plan submitted will be accepted, or that the Company will regain compliance within the plan period or at all. Actual results may differ materially due to risks and uncertainties, including the Company’s ability to implement its compliance initiatives, continued operating losses and funding requirements, and the risk that estimated annualized cost reductions are not sustained or are offset by other expenditures. Additional risks are described under “Risk Factors” in the Company’s Annual Report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026. Forward-looking statements speak as of the date of this release, and the Company undertakes no obligation to update them except as required by applicable law.

data.title: Icahn Enterprises Files 8K - Director, Officer or Compensation Filing >IEP
data.description:
Icahn Enterprises L.P. (IEP) filed a Form 8K - Director, Officer or Compensation Filing - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on November 27, 2026.

On November 27, 2026, the board of directors (the "Board") of Icahn Enterprises G.P. Inc. ("Icahn Enterprises GP"), the general partner of Icahn Enterprises L.P. (the "Company"), approved amended and restated employment letter agreements between the Company and each of Ted Papapostolou, President and Chief Executive Officer of the Company, and Robert Flint, Chief Financial Officer and Secretary of the Company, each of which will become effective on November 30, 2026 (the "Effective Date").

Amended and Restated Employment Letter Agreement with Mr. Papapostolou

The amended and restated employment letter agreement with Mr. Papapostolou (the "Papapostolou Employment Agreement") supersedes in its entirety Mr. Papapostolou's prior employment letter agreement with the Company, effective May 6, 2026 (the "Prior Papapostolou Agreement"). Pursuant to the Papapostolou Employment Agreement, Mr. Papapostolou will continue to serve as President and Chief Executive Officer of the Company, Icahn Enterprises GP and Icahn Enterprises Holdings L.P. The Papapostolou Employment Agreement eliminates the fixed term of employment provided under the Prior Papapostolou Agreement and Mr. Papapostolou's employment will continue on an at-will basis.

Effective as of the Effective Date, Mr. Papapostolou's annualized base salary will increase from $3,500,000 to $6,500,000. Mr. Papapostolou will no longer be eligible to receive further grants of cash-settled deferred depositary units of the Company ("Quarterly Awards") under the Icahn Enterprises L.P. 2017 Long-Term Incentive Plan (the "Plan"). On the Company's first regular payroll date following the Effective Date, Mr. Papapostolou will receive a lump sum cash payment of $340,470.43, less applicable tax and payroll withholdings, for a prorated portion of his outstanding Quarterly Awards and any dividend equivalents credited on that portion. Upon payment, all of his outstanding equity-based awards under the Plan will be cancelled, and all remaining rights under those awards, including rights to dividend equivalents, will be forfeited without further consideration. Mr. Papapostolou is not eligible for an annual discretionary cash bonus.

If Mr. Papapostolou's employment is terminated by the Company without "Cause" (including due to his death or disability) or by Mr. Papapostolou for "Good Reason" (each as defined in the Papapostolou Employment Agreement), Mr. Papapostolou will be entitled to receive, subject to his timely execution and non-revocation of a release of claims, a lump sum cash payment equal to $6,500,000.

The Papapostolou Employment Agreement continues to contain customary confidentiality, intellectual property and non-disparagement covenants, as well as non-solicitation and non-competition provisions that apply during employment and for one year following termination.

The foregoing description of the terms of the Papapostolou Employment Agreement does not purport to be complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the full text of the Papapostolou Employment Agreement, a copy of which is anticipated to be filed as an exhibit to the Company's Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026, and upon such filing, will be incorporated herein by reference.

Amended and Restated Employment Letter Agreement with Mr. Flint

The amended and restated employment letter agreement with Mr. Flint (the "Flint Employment Agreement") supersedes in its entirety Mr. Flint's prior employment letter agreement with the Company, effective May 6, 2026 (the "Prior Flint Agreement"). Pursuant to the Flint Employment Agreement, Mr. Flint will continue to serve as Chief Financial Officer and Secretary of the Company and certain of its subsidiaries. The Flint Employment Agreement eliminates the fixed term of employment provided under the Prior Flint Agreement, and Mr. Flint's employment will continue on an at-will basis.

Effective as of the Effective Date, Mr. Flint's annualized base salary will increase from $1,500,000 to $2,250,000. Mr. Flint will no longer be eligible to receive further grants of Quarterly Awards under the Plan. On the Company's first regular payroll date following the Effective Date, Mr. Flint will receive a lump sum cash payment of $68,094.60, less applicable tax and payroll withholdings, for a prorated portion of his outstanding Quarterly Awards and any dividend equivalents credited on that portion. Upon payment, all of his outstanding equity-based awards under the Plan will be cancelled, and all remaining rights under those awards, including rights to dividend equivalents, will be forfeited without further consideration. Mr. Flint is not eligible for an annual discretionary cash bonus.

If Mr. Flint's employment is terminated by the Company without "Cause" (including due to his death or disability) or by Mr. Flint for "Good Reason" (each as defined in the Flint Employment Agreement), Mr. Flint will be entitled to receive, subject to his timely execution and non-revocation of a release of claims, a lump sum cash payment equal to $2,250,000.

The Flint Employment Agreement continues to contain customary confidentiality, intellectual property and non-disparagement covenants, as well as non-solicitation and non-competition provisions that apply during employment and for one year following termination.

The foregoing description of the terms of the Flint Employment Agreement does not purport to be complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the full text of the Flint Employment Agreement, a copy of which is anticipated to be filed as an exhibit to the Company's Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026, and upon such filing, will be incorporated herein by reference.

data.title: U.S. Dollar Advances Amid Increasing Expectations Of Fed Rate Hike In December
data.description:
WASHINGTON (dpa-AFX) - The U.S. Dollar value moved higher on Friday as the increasing bets on a quarter-point rate hike in the U.S. in December overshadowed the easing of crude oil supply concerns as U.S. persists in diplomatic route for solving the U.S.-Iran crisis.

Today, the U.S. Dollar Index DXY, which measures the Greenback against a basket of other major currencies, was last seen trading at 104.05, up by 0.39 (or 0.38%).

While against the Euro, the USD was trading at 1.093, up by 0.34%, against the GBP, the USD was trading at 1.309, up by 0.08%.

Against the USD, the Japanese Yen was trading at 159.578, down by 0.23%, the Swiss Franc was trading at 0.836, down by 0.21%; and the Canadian Dollar was trading at 1.425, down by 0.01%.

Against one unit of Australian Dollar, the USD was trading at 0.665, down by 0.20%.

On Wednesday, data from the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis revealed that on a month-on-month basis, the U.S. core Personal Consumption Expenditures price index increased 0.30% in October, matching market expectations. On a year-on-year basis, the core PCE index increased 3.30% in October, up from 3.10% in September and slightly above market expectations of 3.20%.

Similarly, the PCE price index increased 0.30% month-over-month in October 2026, following a 0.50% rise in September, and in line with market expectations. On a year-on-year basis, the PCE inflation accelerated to 3.80% in October from 3.70% in August, in line with market expectations.

The U.S. economy expanded an annualized 4.30% in the third quarter of 2026, much higher than 3.40% reported in the advance estimate, and marking the fastest growth rate in three years, reflecting upward revisions to investment and consumer spending.

The mixed data has increased expectations of a rate hike in the U.S.

Recently, Vice Chair of the U.S. Federal Reserve Philip Jefferson, and the Governors of the Federal Reserve Board Michael Barr, Lisa Cook, and Christopher Waller sounded hawkishly and signaled the need for a rate hike to contain inflation.

According to the CME Group's FedWatch Tool, currently investors are betting on a 98.90% chance of a 25-basis-point interest rate hike at the upcoming two-day meeting of the U.S. Federal Reserve on December 8-9 while the odds on the rates being held at the current level (i.e., 3.75% to 4.00%) stand at a slim 1.10%.

Today, the U.S. Census Bureau data showed that the U.S. goods trade deficit widened sharply to $149.50 billion in October, up from a revised $135.10 billion in September, according to preliminary data.

Yesterday in his Thanksgiving address at his residence in Florida, U.S. President Donald Trump remarked that victory in the war with Iran would be achieved whenever he wants it.

Trump stated that he wanted to give another chance for Iran to act smart but he sounded skeptical if the present Iranian regime would utilize the offer.

Trump wanted Iran to use this opportunity to decide wisely and save a lot of lives.

Re-asserting again that Iran can never be allowed to have a nuclear weapon, Trump warned that Iranian missiles can reach up to Europe.

Trump threatened that if no deal is reached with Iran, further U.S. attacks on Iran could even target the strategic Pickaxe Mountain where Iran is suspected of piling up enriched nuclear materials.

As of now, escalation tensions are subdued as markets are pinning on the commitment made by Trump last week that he preferred to wait until January 1 before taking any action on Iran.

data.title: Moffett Says SpaceX Won’t Threaten AT&T, Verizon Or T-Mobile—It’s Competing With CoreWeave Instead
data.description:
Key points:
  • “The obvious question is why,” Moffett continued.
  • Moffett noted SpaceX’s present business is more focused on renting compute.
  • The company’s rival now is “arguably somebody like CoreWeave” and not telecom operators, he added.  

Craig Moffett of MoffettNathanson on Friday pushed back against the idea that SpaceX poses a meaningful competitive threat to AT&T, Verizon, and T-Mobile in terrestrial wireless, instead framing the company as more of a rival to CoreWeave (CRWV), given its current focus on renting compute.

“I really struggle with the narrative that SpaceX is going to be a player in the terrestrial wireless business,” he said in an appearance on CNBC. Moffett argued that the company’s satellite advantage “isn’t really worth that much,” so any serious push would require building a ground network—an effort he thinks will give “much lower returns on capital” as compared to SpaceX’s efforts into sectors such as building out terrestrial data centers.

“The obvious question is why,” Moffett continued. “It’s not [a] business that generates particularly good returns.” He noted SpaceX already faces “close to a trillion dollars of capital projects,” including orbital and terrestrial data centers and a Starbase in Louisiana for Starship development. Inserting a “me-too terrestrial network” into that list, he said, makes little sense to him.

“I don’t see them as terribly threatening, but I also don’t see it as terribly attractive,” he said.

The Real Competition Is In Cloud Compute, He Says

Moffett noted SpaceX’s present business as more focused on renting compute. “SpaceX is not really a space company today. Space is a really important potential business for them, but the core business they’re in is a neo cloud. They are simply a neo cloud. Their closest competitor is arguably somebody like CoreWeave,” he said.

Revenue growth is currently driven by renting compute capacity rather than by proprietary space or wireless services, he noted. SpaceX’s AI efforts such as its chatbot Grok “hasn’t gotten enough traction,” he said, forcing the company to rent its compute outside.

“Is faster growth actually a sign of a good thing or a bad thing for SpaceX? Because it's great to be able to rent your capacity, but it only means that you're not able to use it yourself, and that's probably a sign that Grok is not getting traction with users yet,” he said.

Musk’s Own Concerns About Renting Compute

In its third-quarter (Q3) 2026 results reported in late October, SpaceX’s Super Intelligence (AI) segment generated $7.56 billion in revenue, up roughly 830% year-over-year and accounting for about 52% of the company’s total $14.6 billion in sales, overtaking Starlink for the first time. A bulk of that revenue came from the company renting compute capacity to rivals such as Claude parent Anthropic (ANT) and Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL), with smaller contributions from X advertising, Grok usage, and others.

The New York Times reported on Monday that Musk told employees that SpaceX is falling behind in AI development and is frustrated by the same.

Musk even reportedly changed the name of a group chat with employees temporarily to “Sell compute because we can’t compete” in August.

Meanwhile, Verizon Eyes Deal To Expand Network, SpaceX Eyes Anterix Licenses

Earlier today, Bloomberg reported that SpaceX is eyeing an acquisition of the New Jersey-based Anterix’s s 900 MHz licenses to support expansion of its direct-to-device satellite service. The company could also consider NextNav’s 900MHz licenses instead, the report noted.

The move is in sync with the company’s efforts at trying to put together its own retail wireless network and compete with big mobile network operators like Verizon (VZ), T-Mobile US (TMUS), and AT&T Mobility (T). The company previously acquired a significant tranche of spectrum from EchoStar Corp. in 2025 and 800 MHz licenses from Grain Management in October.

Separately, The Financial Times reported that Verizon is in talks over a roughly $6 billion deal to buy fibre-optic broadband operator Fidium to boost its network availability. The deal talks are ongoing and come on the heels of the company buying Frontier Communications earlier this year. A potential deal may be agreed in coming weeks, the report said.

How Did SPCX Retail Traders React?

On Stocktwits, retail sentiment around SPCX stayed within the 'bullish' territory over the past 24 hours, while message volume fell from 'high' to 'normal' levels.

SPCX stock closed on Friday nearly 5% higher at about $134, below its June IPO price of $135.

data.title: Hi-View Resources Announces Cybersecurity Incident
data.description:
(TheNewswire)

    VANCOUVER, BRITISH COLUMBIA, NOVEMBER 27,  2026 – TheNewswire - HI-VIEW RESOURCES INC. (“Hi-View” or the “Company”) (CSE: GXLD; OTCQB: GXLDF; FSE: B630) announces that the Company has been subject to a social engineering cyberattack by a sophisticated third party that resulted in a wire transfer of the Company’s funds to a fraudulent third-party account. The crime resulted in the misappropriation of $1,564,777.05.

    Upon learning of the incident, the Company took steps to secure its systems and mitigate the impact on the Company’s data and operations. At this time, the Company is not aware of any evidence that any third-party data has been compromised or misused as a result of the incident.  Independent cybersecurity experts have been retained to assist the Company in dealing with the matter in accordance with industry best practices. However, due to the nature of the cybersecurity incident, these efforts may or may not result in the recovery of some or all of the misappropriated funds.

    The Company has notified the appropriate authorities including the Vancouver Police Department’s Financial Crimes Unit which has started an investigation. The Company is working with authorities in furtherance of their investigations as applicable.

    The Company is also actively pursuing all available avenues to recover the misappropriated funds, including working with its financial institutions and exploring all legal remedies against parties that may be responsible for, or have facilitated, the fraudulent transactions. The Company is further assessing all applicable insurance coverage and potential recovery options. The Company intends to take all reasonable steps to protect its interests and seek recovery of the funds.

    Hi-View Resources Inc. is a mineral exploration company listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange. The Company holds a 100% interest in more than 30,635 hectares in the Toodoggone region of northern British Columbia, with no further option payments outstanding on any property. data.title: S&P Revises Outlook on French Credit Rating to Negative From Stable — WSJ
data.description:
By Don Nico Forbes

France's credit outlook was revised to negative from stable by S&P Global Ratings on Friday, paving the way for a rating downgrade as mounting public debt and political uncertainty threaten to undermine efforts to bring the country's finances under control.

France's credit rating was affirmed at A+, but the outlook change signals that S&P sees a greater risk of a downgrade in the coming months if France fails to make progress on reducing its budget deficit and stabilizing its debt burden.

"The negative outlook on France reflects rising government debt against a backdrop of subdued economic growth prospects amid weak political consensus on how to tackle the large underlying budget deficit," S&P said in a statement.

Earlier Friday, France's statistics agency published revised figures that showed the economy entered a recession in the three months through September, with output contracting in both the second and third quarters.

The S&P decision comes as France faces a difficult budget negotiation for 2027, with the government struggling to secure parliamentary backing for measures to reduce the budget deficit. The government is targeting a deficit of 5% next year, but the European Commission forecasts 5.4%.

S&P's decision leaves France with an A+ rating, one notch below its previous AA- rating following a cut in 2025. This leaves the country rated alongside Spain, Portugal and Japan, but below Germany, the U.K. and Belgium, reflecting the deterioration of its fiscal position in recent years.

France's borrowing costs have remained elevated amid investor concerns about the country's fiscal outlook. The yield on France's 10-year government bond stood at around 4.75% on Thursday, while the spread over German bonds was around 1.5 percentage points, after peaking at over 1.7 percentage points earlier this autumn.

The S&P move follows Moody's decision last month to maintain France's rating at Aa3, with a negative outlook, while Fitch revised its outlook on France to negative last month, affirming its rating at A+. An A+ is one grade below Aa3 on the agencies' respective scales.

France's political turmoil has complicated efforts to tackle its fiscal problems since the 2024 snap election left no party with a parliamentary majority, making it difficult for successive governments to secure approval for budgets or advance spending cuts and tax reforms.

The uncertainty is unlikely to dissipate ahead of the 2027 presidential race, with investors questioning whether the next administration will have the political backing to curb borrowing. The prospect of policies proposed by polling front-runner Marine Le Pen on the far right, as well as Jean-Luc Melenchon on the left, has added to concerns about the country's fiscal trajectory.

data.title: GoGo AI Announces Effective Date of Share Consolidation
data.description:
VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- GoGo AI Network Inc. FSE:4E9 (“GoGo” or the “Company”) announces that, further to its news release on November 16, 2026, it will consolidate the common shares of the Company (each, a “Share”) on the basis of one (1) post-consolidation Share for every ten (10) pre-consolidation Shares (the “Consolidation”). The Shares are expected to commence trading on a post-consolidation basis at the opening of the market on December 3, 2026. There is no name change or stock symbol change in connection with the Consolidation. The new CUSIP is 379973209 ISIN:CA3799732092.

The Company currently has 113,819,555 Shares issued and outstanding. Following the Consolidation, approximately 11,381,955 Shares, subject to adjustments for rounding, will be issued and outstanding. No fractional Shares will be issued in connection with the Consolidation, and any fractional Share resulting from the Consolidation will be rounded down to the nearest whole Share.

Endeavor Trust Corporation will mail out a Letter of Transmittal to the shareholders of record on December 3, 2026, providing instructions on exchanging pre-Consolidation share certificates for post-Consolidation share certificates. Shareholders are encouraged to send their share certificates, together with their Letter of Transmittal, to Endeavor in accordance with the instructions in the Letter of Transmittal.

Shareholders who hold their Shares through a broker, investment dealer, bank, trust company or other intermediary are not required to take any action.

About GoGo AI Network Inc.

GoGo AI Network Inc. is an investment issuer focused on identifying, investing in, and supporting early-stage and growth-stage companies developing artificial intelligence, automation, and next-generation software technologies. The Company targets opportunities across multiple sectors and geographies and seeks to create long-term shareholder value through disciplined capital allocation, active portfolio support, and the strategic monetization of its investments over time. For more information, visit www.gogonetwork.ai.
